mainEntity.name: How much does a Mercedes SLK 200 CDI engine replacement cost in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rebuilt OM646 engine for the R171 SLK 200 CDI costs £2,000-£3,200 supply-only; a rebuilt OM651 engine for the R172 SLK 200 CDI costs £2,200-£3,600 supply-only. Fitting adds £800-£1,500 depending on complexity - diesel work requires specialist knowledge.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of swirl flap failure on a Mercedes SLK 200 CDI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rough running, loss of power, and check engine lights are the classic warning signs on the OM646 engine. The plastic swirl flap linkages can break, causing the actuator to fail. Vacuum line cracks can also cause similar symptoms.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of timing chain failure on a Mercedes SLK 200 CDI (OM651)?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rattling noise on cold start is the classic warning sign on the OM651 engine. The rear-mounted timing chain tensioner can lose pressure, allowing chain slack and guide wear.

mainEntity.name: Is the Mercedes SLK 200 CDI engine reliable?

acceptedAnswer.text: The OM646 and OM651 diesel engines are fundamentally efficient and robust, but both have known weak points. The OM646's swirl flap actuator and DPF issues are common but manageable, while the OM651's timing chain tensioner requires proactive attention.

mainEntity.name: How long do Mercedes SLK 200 CDI engines last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly maintained OM646 and OM651 engines routinely reach 150,000-200,000 miles before major work. Timing chain issues on the OM651 typically appear between 70,000-100,000 miles.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in my Mercedes SLK 200 CDI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the SLK is otherwise in good condition with no rust or major transmission faults. A rebuilt OM646 costs £2,000-£3,200 - far less than replacing a £3,000-£12,000 vehicle. SLK 200 CDI values remain strong for well-maintained examples, making engine replacement a worthwhile investment.

historyTimeline.h2: Mercedes Benz SLK 200 CDI - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: The SLK 200 CDI joined the R171 generation in 2004 as Mercedes' first diesel-powered roadster, powered by the OM646 2.1-litre inline-four diesel - a refined common-rail unit delivering strong economy and relaxed cruising. In 2011, the R172 generation introduced the updated OM651 2.1-litre diesel with improved efficiency and lower emissions. These diesel SLKs offered UK owners the perfect blend of open-top motoring and excellent fuel economy, making them popular daily drivers.

milestones.description: OM646.980, 2.1L inline-four turbo diesel, 122hp @ 4,200rpm (SLK 200 CDI, R171 launch)
OM646.980 EVO, 2.1L inline-four turbo diesel, 136hp @ 4,200rpm (R171 update)
OM651.980, 2.1L inline-four turbo diesel, 143hp @ 4,200rpm (SLK 200 CDI, R172 launch)
End of R172 production; SLK renamed SLC

commonProblems.h2: Mercedes Benz SLK 200 CDI Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The SLK 200 CDI's OM646 and OM651 diesel engines are efficient and robust, but both have well-documented weaknesses that become more pronounced with age and mileage. The OM646 suffers from swirl flap actuator failure and DPF regeneration issues, while the OM651 is prone to timing chain tensioner wear and oil cooler seal leaks. Every rebuilt engine supplied through EnginesMarket includes upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: OM646 Swirl Flap Actuator Failure - The R171 Diesel's Driveability Issue
problems.rootCause: The OM646's swirl flap linkages are made of plastic and can wear or break over time, causing the actuator to fail. This leads to rough running, loss of power and check engine lights. The vacuum lines that operate the swirl flaps can also crack with age, causing similar symptoms.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical 2004-2010 SLK 200 CDI is worth approximately £3,000-£8,000 depending on condition and mileage. These diesel roadsters offer excellent value for money, making engine replacement a justifiable investment for well-maintained examples.
problems.recommendation: Swirl flap issues on the OM646 are common but often repairable. If your SLK 200 CDI experiences rough running or loss of power, have the intake manifold inspected immediately. Specialist swirl flap repair at £200-£400 is significantly cheaper than dealer rates. If the actuator has failed, replacement at £350-£650 is a cost-effective solution. On an SLK 200 CDI worth £3,000-£8,000, this is a worthwhile investment.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt OM646 Mercedes SLK 200 CDI engine prices

problems.h4: OM651 Timing Chain Tensioner Wear - The R172 Diesel's Critical Weakness
problems.rootCause: The OM651's rear-mounted timing chain tensioner relies on consistent oil pressure to maintain preload. Sludge buildup from delayed servicing or weak oil pump output allows the chain to slacken, leading to guide rail wear, excessive chain stretch, and potential piston-to-valve contact at high RPM. Cold-start rattling is the classic warning sign.

problems.h4: OM646/OM651 DPF Regeneration & Injector Issues - The Diesel's Emissions Challenge
problems.rootCause: Diesel particulate filter (DPF) regeneration issues are common on SLK 200 CDI models used primarily for short urban journeys. Injector copper seal leaks can also occur, allowing combustion gases to escape and causing diesel fumes in the cabin. Fuel system issues can cause hard starting, hesitation under load, or uneven idle behaviour.

If you experience rough running or diesel fumes, have the injector seals inspected immediately. Specialist DPF regeneration at £150-£300 is significantly cheaper than a full DPF replacement. On an SLK 200 CDI worth £3,000-£12,000, preventative maintenance is always the better investment.
